title: An octanuclear {CuII4DyIII4} coordination cluster showing single molecule magnet behaviour from field accessible states

synthesis.procedure: Complex 1 was isolated from the reaction of CuBr2, Dy(NO3)3·6H2O, H2vanox (3-methoxy-2-hydroxybenzaldoxime) and triethylamine in methanol, giving dark green crystals. The main text and ESI name the reagents and solvent but do not report reagent amounts, temperature, or time.

properties.summary: Octanuclear Cu4Dy4 cluster is an SMM whose slow relaxation and partially open hysteresis arise from field-accessible excited states rather than the low-field nonmagnetic ground state. Dc data show a drop in χT below about 20 K and a field-induced magnetic transition; ac data give an Arrhenius barrier, and microSQUID loops show two level crossings. A competing-exchange model gives ferromagnetic Cu–Dy coupling and antiferromagnetic Dy–Dy and Cu–Cu couplings.

measurements.name: expected χT
measurements.conditions: high temperature; value expected for four uncoupled Cu(II) and four uncoupled Dy(III) ions; measured χT is nearly constant and in line with this value

measurements.name: χT downturn temperature
measurements.conditions: dc susceptibility; sharp decrease in χT below approximately 20 K

measurements.name: magnetization
measurements.conditions: dc magnetization, 2, 3 and 5 K, 0–7 T; derivative of M vs H indicates a transition near 0.5 T at 2 K

measurements.name: Ueff
measurements.conditions: Arrhenius fit of the high-temperature part of the relaxation time extracted from frequency-dependent out-of-phase ac susceptibility

measurements.name: tau0
measurements.conditions: same Arrhenius fit as Ueff; ac driving field 3 Oe, frequencies 1–1500 Hz

measurements.name: magnetic hysteresis level crossings
measurements.conditions: microSQUID, 30 mK, variable field-sweep rates; lower crossing near 0.3 T and higher crossing near 0.7 T

measurements.name: J1
measurements.conditions: Ising exchange model of the low-energy spectrum; ferromagnetic Cu–Dy coupling

measurements.name: J2
measurements.conditions: same exchange model; antiferromagnetic Dy–Dy coupling

measurements.name: J3
measurements.conditions: fixed from the dc susceptibility fit of the Y analogue 2; Cu–Cu coupling

measurements.name: g_Cu
measurements.conditions: fixed from the dc susceptibility fit of 2

measurements.name: g_z(Dy)
measurements.conditions: assumed pure Ising Dy(III) ground doublet, Jz = ±15/2; gx = gy = 0

synthesis.procedure: A reaction analogous to that used for 1, replacing Dy(NO3)3·6H2O with Y(NO3)3·6H2O and using CuBr2, H2vanox and triethylamine in methanol, gave the isostructural Y analogue. The axial bridge between Cu(1) and Cu(2) is a disordered mixture of water (80%) and methanol (20%). Reagent amounts, temperature, and time are not reported.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: reaction in methanol analogous to complex 1
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Isolated as the crystalline Y analogue; crystal structure at 150(2) K.

properties.summary: The diamagnetic Y(III) analogue was used as a magnetic control. Its χT is nearly constant at high temperature and falls below about 10 K. The dc susceptibility is fitted as two isolated Cu dimers.

measurements.name: expected χT
measurements.conditions: high temperature; value expected for four uncoupled Cu(II) ions with diamagnetic Y(III); measured χT is nearly constant and in line with this value

measurements.name: χT downturn temperature

measurements.name: g_Cu
